Impact analysis Impacted 5G architecture options: SA Impacted functionality: Functions in operation with shared spectrum in FR2-2. Inter-operability: If the UE is implemented according to this CR and the network is not, then there will be interoperability issues since network may configure values for monitoringSlotPeriodicityAndOffset which may not be supported by the UE for 960 kHz SCS.
